content: {"summary":"In early May 2026 the fraud‑scorer pods began logging FRD‑E140 because writes to the single‑node feature store (redis‑features‑01) were rejected with “OOM command not allowed”. The store had hit its maxmemory 24 GB limit while configured with a noeviction policy, so further writes were blocked. After memory was freed or the cap raised, writes resumed and the FRD‑E140 errors stopped. The runbook (RB‑019) directs operators to first examine memory usage, maxmemory settings, eviction policy and the stop‑writes‑on‑bgsave‑error flag.","likely_cause":"Redis hit its configured maxmemory limit (24 GB) with a noeviction policy, causing OOM write rejections that blocked fraud‑scorer velocity‑counter updates.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Redis refused writes with an OOM error","evidence_ids":["INC-0155#0"],"quote":"the refusal text from redis-features-01 was `OOM command not allowed`"},{"text":"Memory usage had reached the maxmemory limit and the store used noeviction","evidence_ids":["INC-0155#1"],"quote":"memory use had reached `maxmemory 24gb`, and the store is configured with `noeviction`"},{"text":"Both fraud‑scorer pods logged FRD‑E140 when writes were refused","evidence_ids":["INC-0155#0"],"quote":"both scorer pods logged `FRD-E140`"},{"text":"Writes were accepted again and FRD‑E140 stopped after the issue was cleared","evidence_ids":["INC-0155#1"],"quote":"writes were accepted again and `FRD-E140` had stopped"},{"text":"Runbook RB‑019 lists maxmemory, policy and stop‑writes‑on‑bgsave‑error as key settings to check","evidence_ids":["RB-019#0"],"quote":"# maxmemory 24gb, maxmemory-policy noeviction, stop-writes-on-bgsave-error yes"}],"next_checks":["Verify current memory usage and maxmemory setting on redis‑features‑01","Confirm the maxmemory‑policy (noeviction) and consider changing it or adding eviction","Check for any recent background‑save errors (stop‑writes‑on‑bgsave‑error)","Identify large keys or feature data that can be expired to free memory","Review Sentinel master address and replication lag to ensure no failover issues"]}
